subject: Meditech compliance discovery — follow-up & requested artifacts
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@meditech.health>; Meditech Security <security@meditech.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-24T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Meditech compliance discovery — follow-up & requested artifacts

Hi Elaine / security team — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and our recommended next steps from the call: 

Summary of what we discussed:
- Primary use case: near-real-time summarization of provider notes (PHI workflows) — expected PII/PHI in requests, will need HIPAA-safe handling and BAAs.
- SOC 2: you are currently Type II in progress, expected completion Q1 2027. You flagged controls around incident response and vendor onboarding as focus areas.
- Data residency: production data will remain in us-east-1; some analytics exports may go to a partner bucket in eu-west-1 (TBD).
- Subprocessors: you requested a vendor roster for cloud infra, embeddings hosting, and telemetry.

Action items (owner / ETA):
1) We will initiate the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) and send a redacted subprocessor template you can populate (SoojIN). — Soojin — EOD 10/25
2) Ben will share our standard SOC 2/hipaa evidence checklist and a short write-up on our isolation model for PHI. — Ben — 10/26
3) Meditech to share the current vendor list + procurement contact & any contract-play constraints (e.g., specific KMS/HSM requirements). — Meditech
4) Align on whether analytics exports to eu-west-1 are allowed — key for quantization of logs. — Both teams — by 10/29

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_template.csv (CSV template to map processors/processors' purpose, data types, region)

If that aligns, I'll send the VSQ kickoff email and upload the template to the HubSpot deal record.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference for production
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@meditech.health>

Date: 2026-10-25T09:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Meditech compliance discovery — follow-up & requested artifacts

Thanks Soojin — helpful recap. A few clarifying points before you push the VSQ: 

1) SOC 2 timeline: we're in the final audit stage; our Compliance Ops lead expects report delivery by 2027-01-15. We can share the current control narrative and our previous Type I report.
2) HIPAA: we do require a BAA for any vendor touching PHI. Please include your BAA draft or indicate that Redwood has a standard BAA.
3) Data flows: the provider-notes workflow will send raw text to your inference endpoint; we need to confirm token retention/retention for caching and any logs that contain PII.

I'll ask procurement to export our current vendor roster and procurements lead contact — they'll aim to send by EOD 10/26. If you can include a short note in the VSQ about retention policies (KV cache retention defaults, option to disable caching), that would speed approval.

Elaine
Elaine Wu
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Meditech Health
elaine.wu@meditech.health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-25T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Meditech compliance discovery — vendor artifacts and SOC2 notes

Elaine — adding the templates and a short answers doc for the items you flagged. Attached: redwood_subprocessor_template.csv and redwood_security_evidence_qs.docx (short checklist). Highlights: 
- SOC 2: Redwood is Type II (report available) — our most recent audit period covers 2025-09 to 2026-03. We will share the report under NDA; if you prefer we can push the summary into a secure share.
- HIPAA/BAA: We have a standard BAA and can provide a redline-friendly version; note our private deployments support customer-managed KMS for HSM-level key control.
- Caching & retention: by default KV cache retention is 2 hours for inference sessions; logs that include PII are redacted before long-term storage and can be configured to never persist. We'll call out exact config options in the VSQ.

Attachment stubs:
- redwood_subprocessor_template.csv (csv)
- redwood_security_evidence_qs.docx (docx)

Soojin — please go ahead and send the VSQ kickoff to Elaine + security when ready. I'll also drop the SOC2 summary to the HubSpot deal and request an NDA if they want the full report.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Hi Soojin / Ben — thanks for the materials. Attached is our current vendor list (exported from procurement) and the procurement lead contact for contract routing. A couple notes: 

- Vendor list attached: meditech_vendor_list.xlsx (contains vendor name, purpose, data types processed, region, and contract owner). Please map the processors in your template to these entries where applicable.
- Procurement contact: procurement@meditech.health (attn: Marco Reyes) — they'll handle redlines and contract questions.
- We require the BAA to be part of the initial contract packet. Marco will confirm if they need our standard security questionnaire filled or prefer a vendor-uploaded package.
- Regarding analytics export to eu-west-1: not approved yet. We'll escalate with Product; expect a decision next week.

Forwarding the thread to procurement for visibility.

Thanks,
